items.title: Merck (MRK) Starts ENHANCE 3 COPD Trial As Cancer Drug Review Nears
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) has begun the ENHANCE-3 Phase 3 trial to study OHTUVAYRE as a maintenance treatment for COPD. OHTUVAYRE recently received U.S. approval as the first new inhaled COPD maintenance option with dual bronchodilatory and anti-inflammatory action in over 20 years. The FDA has granted priority review to sacituzumab tirumotecan for endometrial cancer as Merck expands its late-stage oncology and HIV pipelines.
